description: Held-out set (2026-10-27). 40 queries written and labeled by a separate agent that did not run search-docs, this evaluator, the llm-wiki CLI or any MCP search tool, and did not grep the query strings over the wiki: relevance was judged by reading the documents. About 22 queries start outside the wiki (git commit subjects, CHANGELOG entries, README) and about 18 from task situations. The ranker shipped in 1.36.0 was chosen on queries.json before this set existed, and no label here was edited after a ranker was run against it. Agent-labeled, not human-reviewed; long documents (REVIEW_HISTORY, HARNESS_GOVERNANCE_ROADMAP, BENCHMARK, domains/00_overview) were judged from their headings only, so a relevant document may be missing from a label.
corpus: docs/llm-wiki (release notes included; templates and change logs excluded)
